title: R100-SL dwelling: all R-Codes provisions apply subject to the Table 2.10a modifications
text: Housing on lots less than 100m2 – applies to single houses and grouped dwellings in areas coded R100-SL only. C2.10.1 Single houses in areas coded R100-SL are to comply with the following: ii. all provisions of the R-Codes to apply, subject to the modifications in Table 2.10a.

replaces.note: 85% site cover row and ceiling height row removed; balcony/roof terrace POS alternative removed; boundary wall cross-reference now C3.4.5

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: Not evaluated here: Table 2.10a modifies values owned by elements 1.1, 1.2, 3.2, 3.3, 3.4, 3.6, 3.9 and 3.10; those parts carry R100-SL variants of their rules. The table is tables/table-2.10a.json. Footnote 1: where development abuts an adjoining property not coded R100-SL, the modified provisions for 3.4, 3.9 and 3.10 do not apply. Register ch2-035: ToC says 'no modifications made' but the 85% site cover cap and the ceiling height row are gone, the 'OR one POS (balcony/roof terrace)' option is removed, and the boundary wall cross-reference should be C3.4.4 (table) not C3.4.5 (abutting existing wall).

verified.note: Ambiguous on the page: the element sub-heading (p24) reads 'Housing on lots less than 100m2 – applies to single houses and grouped dwellings in areas coded R100-SL only', while C2.10.1 names only the R100-SL coding; whether an R100-SL lot of 100m2 or more is caught is not stated.
